coverage.openapi: health endpoint only; no claim of full REST coverage
coverage.cli: core startup and serve flags; other commands omitted
coverage.features: documented development capabilities; not production certification

cli.name: --dev
cli.description: Development logs; embedded PostgreSQL if DATABASE_URL is absent.

cli.name: --encryptionEnv
cli.description: Name of environment variable holding the 32-character settings encryption key.

cli.name: --http
cli.description: HTTP listener address; domain arguments change the default.

cli.name: --origins
cli.description: Allowed CORS origins; review and restrict for the intended application.

configuration.name: DATABASE_URL
configuration.description: Main PostgreSQL connection string; keep credentials private.

configuration.name: RUXBASE_LOGS_URL
configuration.description: Optional separate PostgreSQL connection string for logs.

configuration.name: RUXBASE_DB_MAX_CONNS
configuration.description: Main pool connection limit when not set by Go configuration.

configuration.name: RUXBASE_DB_CONN_MAX_LIFETIME
configuration.description: Connection lifetime as a Go duration.

configuration.name: RUXBASE_CLUSTER
configuration.description: Enables cluster mode; see clustering constraints.

configuration.name: RUXBASE_REALTIME_SOURCE
configuration.description: Realtime source: hooks or replication; see requirements and fallback behavior.

configuration.name: RUXBASE_RLS_STRICT
configuration.description: Additional RLS enforcement for supported non-superuser list and view queries; see documented limitations.

features.limitations: Embedded PostgreSQL for development; review platform limitations.
Compatibility is bounded by documented differences.
Only supported rules and scopes; not a universal isolation guarantee.
Hooks or logical replication with documented limitations.
Optional integration; review its access rules.
Follow supported import scope and limitations.
